verdict.rationale: Apple's support docs give a concrete, derivable spec: memory bandwidth (546GB/s for the 40-core GPU config) and mentions of up to ~192GB unified memory capability inferred from LLM claims ("nearly 200 billion parameters"), but there's no explicit published memory type (e.g. LPDDR5X spec) or a clear capacity ceiling table across all M4 Max configurations. missing for 10: explicit memory type/spec sheet, full capacity ceiling across all SKUs, independent bandwidth verification.
